# Remote-URL allowlist contrast table for session-sync-init.sh / session-sync-init.ps1 (#1773).
#
# One entry per line, TAB-separated: <ALLOW|DENY><TAB><url>.
# Lines starting with `#` and blank lines are ignored.
#
# Single source of truth for both language suites so the two regexes can never
# drift apart. Four consumers enumerate it, each covering one engine x one layer:
#   tests/main-session-sync/security.sh              bash ERE, pattern + installer
#   tests/main-session-sync-security.Tests.ps1       .NET regex, pattern + installer
# The patterns themselves live in session-sync-remote-url-patterns.txt.
#
# Contract: only https / ssh / git schemes with a non-empty host body, plus the
# SCP-like `user@host:path` form, are accepted. Everything else is refused
# before the URL can reach `git remote add` / `git remote set-url`.
#
# Path content is deliberately unconstrained on an otherwise-allowed URL: the
# URL reaches git as one argv element, never a shell word, so metacharacters
# inside the path are inert. The vectors that matter — remote-helper schemes
# (`ext::`, `fd::`), leading-dash option injection, and scheme-less junk — are
# rejected by the shape of the URL, and are enumerated below.

# --- ALLOW -----------------------------------------------------------------
ALLOW	https://github.com/nirecom/agent-sessions.git
ALLOW	ssh://git@github.com/nirecom/agent-sessions.git
ALLOW	git://example.com/repo.git
# Shipped default (SCP-like form) — must never be rejected by its own installer.
ALLOW	git@github.com:nirecom/agent-sessions.git
# SCP-like with a bare repo path (no owner segment).
ALLOW	git@example.com:repo.git
# Legitimate userinfo.
ALLOW	https://user@example.com/repo.git
# Legitimate IPv6 literal — still accepted after the round-3 bracket tightening.
ALLOW	https://[::1]/repo
# Explicit port, with and without userinfo and IPv6.
ALLOW	https://example.com:8443/repo.git
ALLOW	ssh://git@github.com:22/nirecom/agent-sessions.git
ALLOW	ssh://git@[::1]:2222/repo.git
# No `.git` suffix: the path is not constrained, only the authority is.
ALLOW	https://github.com/nirecom/agent-sessions
# Minimal authority: a single-character host with no path at all. The documented
# pattern allows it, so an implementation that demands a dot, a path, or a
# multi-character host is over-broad refusal — one row per allowed scheme, since
# the three share the alternation and could diverge (CPR-ORTH).
ALLOW	https://a
ALLOW	ssh://a
ALLOW	git://a
# Minimal authority with an empty (root) path — the `(/.*)?` group matching just
# the separator.
ALLOW	https://a/

# --- DENY ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Scheme-less local path: the pre-#1773 fixture form, now refused.
DENY	/tmp/some/local/path
# file:// is outside the allowlist.
DENY	file:///tmp/some/local/path
# The RCE vector named by the issue: git's ext:: transport executes the command.
DENY	ext::sh -c "touch pwned"
# The sibling remote-helper scheme, same class as ext::.
DENY	fd::/dev/null
# Non-allowlisted scheme.
DENY	ftp://example.com/repo.git
# Near-miss of an allowed scheme: http is not https.
DENY	http://example.com/repo.git
# Empty host.
DENY	https:///nohost
# Incomplete SCP-like form: no colon, no path.
DENY	user@host
# SCP-like form with an empty path after the colon.
DENY	git@github.com:
# Empty host reached by backtracking the userinfo group into the host group.
DENY	https://user@/repo
# Empty userinfo.
DENY	https://@host
# Two userinfo separators: the real host is not the one a reader sees first.
DENY	https://user@host@evil.com/repo
# Host body absent, port only.
DENY	ssh://user@:22/repo
# Malformed IPv6 literal: no hex group at all inside the brackets.
DENY	https://[::::]/repo
# Unterminated IPv6 bracket.
DENY	https://[::1/repo
# IPv6 literal with the brackets omitted altogether.
DENY	https://::1/repo
# Space inside the host.
DENY	https://exa mple.com/repo
# Leading dash: git argument injection, not a URL at all.
DENY	--upload-pack=touch pwned
# Shell metacharacters with no scheme and no SCP shape.
DENY	$(touch pwned)
DENY	`touch pwned`.git
